children.name: alias
children.description: Property name to use as entrypoint to the service

children.name: name
children.description: The alias name or list of alias names for the service entry point.

children.name: entity
children.description: The entity name associated with this alias.

children.name: filterable
children.description: The list of fields that can be used as filters when querying through this alias.

children.name: __internal
children.description: Internal-only alias metadata used by the query layer.

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: fieldAlias
children.description: alias for deeper nested relationships (e.g. { 'price': 'prices.calculated\_price\_set.amount' })

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: schema
children.description: GraphQL schema for the all module's available entities and fields

children.name: alias
children.description: The alias used to reference the related service in queries.

children.name: foreignKey
children.description: The foreign key field on the related service used to join the relationship.

children.name: primaryKey
children.description: The primary key field on the current service used to join the relationship.

children.name: serviceName
children.description: The name of the related service.

children.name: entity
children.description: The entity name within the related service.

children.name: inverse
children.description: In an inverted relationship the foreign key is on the other service and the primary key is on the current service

children.name: isList
children.description: Force the relationship to return a list

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: deleteCascade
children.description: If true, the link joiner will cascade deleting the relationship

children.name: filterable
children.description: The fields to be filterable by the Index module using query.index

children.name: hasMany
children.description:
Allow multiple relationships to exist for this
entity

children.name: isLink
children.description: If the module is a link module

children.name: linkableKeys
children.description: Keys that can be used to link to other modules. e.g { product\_id: "Product" } "Product" being the entity it refers to

children.name: isReadOnlyLink
children.description: If true it expands a RemoteQuery property but doesn't create a pivot table

children.name: extraDataFields
children.description:
Fields that will be part of the link record aside from the primary keys that can be updated
If not explicitly defined, this array will be populated by databaseConfig.extraFields

children.name: databaseClientUrl
children.description: Resolved database client URL for this module. This is used to determine if we can do in-DB cross module filtering

children.name: tableName
children.description: Name of the pivot table. If not provided it is auto generated

children.name: idPrefix
children.description: Prefix for the id column. If not provided it is "link"
